name: Bingo Game
tagline: Real-time multiplayer Bingo across mobile, web, and server.
description: A full multiplayer Bingo system rebuilt from the ground up with three coordinated components: a Flutter mobile app, a Node.js + Socket.io backend for real-time game state, and a React web client. Players join rooms, mark numbers live, and see opponents' boards update instantly.

steps.title: Architecture & real-time layer
steps.detail: Designed the room/lobby system and chose Socket.io for bi-directional game-state sync between every connected client.

steps.title: Backend game engine
steps.detail: Built the Node.js server to generate boards, validate calls, detect win patterns, and broadcast state diffs to all players in a room.

steps.title: Web client
steps.detail: Built the React frontend with live board rendering, animated number calls, and room creation/joining flow.

steps.title: Flutter mobile app
steps.detail: Rebuilt the same game logic natively in Flutter so mobile players share the exact same backend and rooms as web players.

steps.title: Polish & deployment
steps.detail: Added win animations, reconnect handling for dropped connections, and deployed web + backend independently.

documents.label: System Architecture
documents.description: Room lifecycle, socket event map, and client/server responsibility split.

name: AI Interview Assistant
tagline: Practice interviews with an AI that listens, watches, and scores you.
description: A flagship portfolio project: an AI-powered mock interview platform with live voice input, camera-based presence tracking, and Groq-powered AI scoring of answers. Built to simulate the pressure and feedback loop of a real technical interview.

steps.title: Voice input pipeline
steps.detail: Integrated the Web Speech API to capture spoken answers and transcribe them in real time for scoring.

steps.title: Camera integration
steps.detail: Added live camera feed to simulate interview presence and engagement tracking during sessions.

steps.title: AI scoring engine
steps.detail: Connected Groq AI to evaluate transcribed answers against question intent, returning structured feedback and a score.

steps.title: Session flow & UI
steps.detail: Built the question flow, timer, and results screen so a full mock interview feels continuous and realistic.

documents.label: Scoring Pipeline
documents.description: How transcribed answers flow into Groq and map back to a structured score.

name: ApnaStay
tagline: Property rental and accommodation discovery platform.
description: A property rental and accommodation platform for finding the right stay, with listing search, filters, and a clean booking-style browsing experience.

steps.title: Listing search & filters
steps.detail: Built search and filtering across property listings for location, price, and type.

steps.title: Booking-style UI
steps.detail: Designed a clean, browsing-first interface modeled on real accommodation platforms.

name: MyVault
description: A personal productivity super-app that keeps tasks, study sessions, money, schedule, projects and daily motivation in one secure place. Everything works offline without an account and is stored AES-encrypted on-device, with optional Firebase sync across devices, PIN + biometric lock for sensitive sections, and smart reminders.

steps.title: Encryption layer
steps.detail: Implemented AES encryption with a fresh random IV on every write, so all local data is unreadable outside the app.

steps.title: Offline-first storage & sync
steps.detail: Built encrypted local storage that works with zero network, plus an optional Firebase Auth + Firestore sync that merges changes by updatedAt when online.

steps.title: PIN & biometric lock
steps.detail: Protected the Study, Money, Schedule and Projects sections with a PIN kept in secure storage and biometric unlock.

steps.title: Productivity modules
steps.detail: Shipped a dashboard, daily/weekly tasks with constant goals, study tracker, weekly budgets with expense capture, calendar with reminders, and charts powered by fl_chart.

steps.title: Responsive layout & themes
steps.detail: Added Material 3 light/dark themes with bottom navigation on phones and side navigation on tablets and desktop.

name: Hover Dictionary
tagline: Pause your cursor over any word on screen and get its definition instantly.
description: A Windows background tool that watches your cursor, reads the text near it using OCR, and pops up a definition when you pause over a word. It works over any app — PDFs, e-books, even images of text — and looks words up in a bundled offline dictionary of about 263,000 English words, so no internet is needed.

steps.title: Cursor tracking
steps.detail: A background mouse listener detects when the cursor rests for about 0.6s and grabs a small screenshot around it.

steps.title: OCR word detection
steps.detail: Tesseract reads the captured region, returns each word's position, and the closest word to the cursor is picked while skipping very short and common words.

steps.title: Offline dictionary
steps.detail: Built a SQLite database from Wiktionary data covering roughly 263,000 words with part of speech and examples, so lookups never touch the internet.

steps.title: Popup, speech & tray
steps.detail: Added a popup with offline text-to-speech, a system tray icon to pause or quit, and logging for troubleshooting.

steps.title: Installer packaging
steps.detail: Packaged the app into a standalone exe with PyInstaller and a Windows setup installer with Inno Setup, bundling Tesseract so users need no Python.

name: Deskline — Internal Helpdesk
tagline: IT ticketing system with real-time updates and automatic SLA escalation.
description: A full-stack internal tool for raising and resolving IT and support tickets. Employees see their own tickets while admins see everything and assign work, with live updates over Socket.io and an hourly job that escalates unassigned tickets by email once they breach the SLA.

steps.title: Auth & role-based access
steps.detail: JWT + bcrypt auth with employee and admin roles, enforced on the API itself so the frontend is never trusted to hide data.

steps.title: Ticket state machine
steps.detail: Tickets move Open → In Progress → Resolved → Closed, with reopening allowed, validated server-side.

steps.title: Real-time sync
steps.detail: Authenticated Socket.io rooms push ticket and comment events only to the users allowed to see them.

steps.title: SLA escalation
steps.detail: A node-cron job runs hourly, finds unassigned open tickets past the SLA window, emails admins once, and marks them escalated.

name: Kritika Dry Cleaners
tagline: Laundry management system built for a real dry cleaning shop.
description: A freelance Laundry Management System that digitises shop operations: customer records, multi-item laundry orders, delivery dates, payment tracking and a five-stage order status flow from Order Received to Delivered.

steps.title: Data model
steps.detail: Designed Customer, Order and Order Item collections with a one-to-many relationship from customers to orders to items.

steps.title: REST API
steps.detail: Built Express endpoints for customers, orders, order status updates and payments.

steps.title: Order workflow
steps.detail: Implemented status tracking across Order Received, Washing, Processing, Ready and Delivered, with totals and payment status per order.

steps.title: Deployment
steps.detail: Deployed the app on Vercel for the shop's day-to-day use.

name: DeepWork
tagline: Chrome extension that blocks distracting sites on a schedule you set.
description: A Manifest V3 Chrome extension that blocks a list of sites during hours you choose, per day of the week, so studying and coding sessions stay distraction-free. It runs fully offline using Chrome's declarativeNetRequest API and redirects blocked sites to a focus-mode page. Built as a learning project to understand how extensions work.

steps.title: Blocking engine
steps.detail: A background service worker checks the schedule every minute and adds or removes declarativeNetRequest block rules.

steps.title: Schedule & site settings
steps.detail: Options page to set blocked domains, start and end time (overnight windows supported) and active days.

steps.title: Popup & blocked page
steps.detail: A toolbar popup shows current status and blocked sites redirect to a focus-mode page.

steps.title: Sync
steps.detail: Settings are stored with chrome.storage.sync so they carry across devices when signed into Chrome.
